sources.license: MIT, copyright (c) 2026 Joost de Winter, by LICENSE at the pin (1,072 bytes, SHA-256 324f918c18cdddf76fb5365f1ff8b3c126bf83ab47937c59d1d2443ba61b9c7a, added in 9bf5d9be on 2026-10-17 and byte-identical to the LICENSE the de-winter-upper-bounds-227-229-260-2026-10-17 packet retains); the root README says all files are released under it. The issue and above324/README.md say the packings at 413, 494, 543, 547, 738, 739 and 810 are square sub-windows of Francisco Couzo's packings at 544, 539, 590, 696, 851, 851 and 868 (jlevy/squares#763 and franciscouzo/square-packing 43f666c), re-optimized, 753 a sub-window of the 810 packing here, and the rest borders or a deletion of these; the issue credits the source arrangements to Couzo.
claims: above324/ holds fifteen exact rational certificates nNNNN.cert, at 413, 494, 539, 543, 547, 590, 738, 739, 753, 794, 809, 810, 851, 867 and 910: two comment lines, then the data line 'n S' with S an exact decimal fraction, then n rows 'x y t', a rational centre and the rational tangent of each unit square's half-angle (Evan Daniel's format with two comment lines). #941 and above324/README.md print each side rounded up at 10 places: 413 20.8239520077, 494 22.7365988643, 539 23.7365988643, 543 23.8024287170, 547 23.8787301198, 590 24.8024287170, 738 27.6912062515, 739 27.6912835939, 753 27.9026514302, 794 28.6912835939, 809 28.9079170470, 810 28.9079170470, 851 29.6912835939, 867 29.9079170470, 910 30.6912835939, each below 'the best value I could find in this repository at commit 200f2eb (all registered claims, with their monotonicity and border consequences)'. d3a020e's README printed the same sides for its nine.

Each certificate's second comment line states its origin: at 413, 543 and 547 a sub-window of Couzo's packing at 544, 590 and 696, re-optimized, the side within 1e-43 above the local optimum of the arrangement; at 494, 738, 739 and 810 a sub-window of his packing at 539, 851, 851 and 868, re-optimized, with a margin of about 5e-9 above the numerical optimum; at 753 a sub-window of the 810 certificate here, re-optimized, with the same margin; at 539, 590, 794, 851, 867 and 910 the certificate at 494, 543, 739, 794, 810 and 851 plus a border of 45, 47, 55, 57, 57 and 59 axis-aligned squares; at 809 the 810 certificate with one square removed. The issue says the local optimality statements rest on a numerical solution of the optimality conditions to 65 digits and have no formal proof, and that public submission files of the Kaggle competition 'Squares in Squares' contain smaller packings for 14 of the 15 counts (all but 543).

verify_cert.py (Python standard library, fractions.Fraction) checks containment and a separating-axis test on all pairs of squares with centres closer than sqrt(2); the issue says a second script with separate code checked the same packings in the same arithmetic, that the checkers share one author, the separating-axis test and Fraction, and that the certificates were not replayed with this repository's checkers. The issue says the sub-window search, local optimization, high-precision solution, rational certificates, checks and figures were produced with Claude (Anthropic) under Joost de Winter's direction. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
